svg.title: End-to-end serving throughput on NVIDIA B300

cc:Work.dc:title: End-to-end serving throughput on NVIDIA B300
cc:Work.dc:description: Paper throughput results in two rows: 64K input / 2K output at TP=1 and 128K input / 2K output at TP=2. Each row compares Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Hollow markers indicate exceeded KV capacity. Rates include queueing; TurboQuant uses 100 output tokens and a 32-token baseline, other methods use 2048 output tokens and a 128-token baseline.
